title: Admissions
description: Applications from parents, online or at the office, from first review to enrollment.
searchPlaceholder: Search name, ref no. or phone

empty.title: No applications here
empty.description: Applications from the public form and the office appear here.

detail.previewDemo: This sample document has no file to open.
detail.enrollFrom: The Enroll button opens on this date.
detail.enrollOpen: The student can be enrolled now.
detail.unreachable: This parent has no email and no mobile number, so they can't receive updates. Please phone them.

actions.scheduleBody: The parent gets the interview time by email and SMS, and sees it on the status page.
actions.changeDateBody: The parent is told the new date by email and SMS.
actions.acceptBody: The parent gets the enrolment date by email and SMS. The student can be enrolled from that date.
actions.rejectBody: The parent is told by email and SMS that a place couldn't be offered.
actions.withdrawBody: Use this when the parent no longer wants a place.

enroll.title: Enroll {name}
enroll.body: Creates the student record, links the guardian, issues the first invoice (admission fee, deposit and this month's tuition) and tells the parent.
enroll.invite: Email the parent an invitation to the parent portal
enroll.choicesLater: Subjects can also be chosen later on the student's page.

walkIn.title: New application
walkIn.description: For a parent at the school. Only the email and documents can wait until later.
walkIn.phoneHint: Use a mobile number if they have one: only mobiles can receive SMS updates.
walkIn.emailHint: Also gives them a parent-portal invitation when the student is enrolled.
walkIn.documentsHint: Add what the parent has brought. The rest can be added to the application later.
walkIn.consent: The parent confirmed these details are correct and agreed that the school may store them to process this application.
walkIn.consentRequired: Please confirm with the parent to continue.
walkIn.trackHow: To follow this application, go to {url} and enter this number with the phone number {contact}.
walkIn.sent: The tracking number was also sent to the parent.
walkIn.notSent: The parent can't receive messages on these details, so please give them this slip.
